Shared/VA-source payouts post synchronously from payouts (initiated at create, processed/failed/reversed on FTS status); Direct-account payouts are statement-driven DA journals posted by the monolith (PS emitter deprecated); merchant balance is a materialised column updated in the same DB txn as the journal.

families.label: Direct-account balance refresh, MAR and in-flight reservations
families.description: x-balances polls bank balances per channel via Mozart (creds from banking-accounts), overwrites balance.balance/last_fetched_at, dual-writes to monolith BASD and (DCS-gated) publishes BalanceRefreshEvent; payouts selects the source account via ListAccounts (MAR), gates Direct dispatch on x-balances balance minus Redis in-flight reservations, and releases awaiting holds when last_fetched_at passes dispatched_at+lag.

families.label: Bank statements, UTR matching, repair (XAS / PS BAS / ART)
families.description: Bank current-account statements are ingested (PS RBL worker, XAS multi-bank, monolith legacy) and matched to payout/reversal source events by UTR→GRN→CMS + balance/account + amount; matches flow back as payout_update (transaction_id / reversal) and, for Direct accounts, DA ledger journals; ART supplies human-gated repair via FTS attempt actions and BAS batch linking.

families.label: Contacts and fund accounts (beneficiaries)
families.description: CFA owns contact/fund-account CRUD with hash-based dedup and structural validation only; MongoDB is the write store with API-DB read fallback and 30s-delayed SQS dual-write; real verification (penny-drop) is ValidX's, and CFA has no verified/unverified gate.

families.label: Virtual-account (Lite VA / sub-balance / VA-to-VA) sourced payouts
families.description: Payouts from a shared/Lite VA or a sub_balance draw on a ledger MerchantBalance account discovered by banking_account_id; x-balances overwrites its stored number from ledger for shared/sub_balance rows. The payouts service posts va_to_va_payout_initiated and va_to_va_payout_failed (there is deliberately NO va_to_va_payout_reversed config -- failed and reversed both map to _failed), and the receiving/limit-allocation side va_to_va_credit_processed is posted by X-BALANCES from its sub_balance_limits service, not by the monolith. IMPORTANT SCOPE CORRECTION: the razorpay/virtual-account repo is inbound-collections only -- it initiates no payouts, performs no VA-to-VA transfer and writes no journal; it only resolves a banking-VA balance_id through x-balances ListAccounts and tracks money received in its own DynamoDB credits table. Nothing here runs in the twin.
